    dispatch_cooldown: integer(),
    engine: atom(),
    get_dynamic_repo: nil or (-> atom() or pid()) or {atom(), atom(), list(term())},
    insert_trigger: boolean(),
    log:
      :alert or :critical or :debug or :emergency or :error or false or :info or :notice or
        :warning,
    node: binary(),
    notifier: {atom(), list({atom(), term()})},
    peer: {atom(), list({atom(), term()})},
    plugins: list(atom() or {atom() or list({atom(), term()})}),
    prefix: false or binary(),
    queues: list({atom(), list({atom(), term()})}),
    repo: atom(),
    shutdown_grace_period: integer(),
    stage_interval: :infinity or integer(),
    testing: :disabled or :inline or :manual
  },
  job: %Oban.Job{
    id: integer(),
    state: binary(),
    queue: binary(),
    worker: binary(),
    args: map(),
    meta: map(),
    tags: list(binary()),
    errors:
      list(%{
        at: %DateTime{
          year: integer(),
          month: integer(),
          day: integer(),
          hour: integer(),
          minute: integer(),
          second: integer(),
          time_zone: binary(),
          zone_abbr: binary(),
          utc_offset: integer(),
          std_offset: integer(),
          microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
          calendar: atom()
        },
        attempt: integer(),
        error: binary()
      }),
    attempt: integer(),
    attempted_by: nil or list(binary()),
    max_attempts: integer(),
    priority: integer(),
    attempted_at:
      %DateTime{
        year: integer(),
        month: integer(),
        day: integer(),
        hour: integer(),
        minute: integer(),
        second: integer(),
        time_zone: binary(),
        zone_abbr: binary(),
        utc_offset: integer(),
        std_offset: integer(),
        microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
        calendar: atom()
      } or nil,
    cancelled_at:
      %DateTime{
        year: integer(),
        month: integer(),
        day: integer(),
        hour: integer(),
        minute: integer(),
        second: integer(),
        time_zone: binary(),
        zone_abbr: binary(),
        utc_offset: integer(),
        std_offset: integer(),
        microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
        calendar: atom()
      } or nil,
    completed_at:
      %DateTime{
        year: integer(),
        month: integer(),
        day: integer(),
        hour: integer(),
        minute: integer(),
        second: integer(),
        time_zone: binary(),
        zone_abbr: binary(),
        utc_offset: integer(),
        std_offset: integer(),
        microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
        calendar: atom()
      } or nil,
    discarded_at:
      %DateTime{
        year: integer(),
        month: integer(),
        day: integer(),
        hour: integer(),
        minute: integer(),
        second: integer(),
        time_zone: binary(),
        zone_abbr: binary(),
        utc_offset: integer(),
        std_offset: integer(),
        microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
        calendar: atom()
      } or nil,
    inserted_at: %DateTime{
      year: integer(),
      month: integer(),
      day: integer(),
      hour: integer(),
      minute: integer(),
      second: integer(),
      time_zone: binary(),
      zone_abbr: binary(),
      utc_offset: integer(),
      std_offset: integer(),
      microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
      calendar: atom()
    },
    scheduled_at: %DateTime{
      year: integer(),
      month: integer(),
      day: integer(),
      hour: integer(),
      minute: integer(),
      second: integer(),
      time_zone: binary(),
      zone_abbr: binary(),
      utc_offset: integer(),
      std_offset: integer(),
      microsecond: {integer(), integer()},
      calendar: atom()
    },
    conf:
      %Oban.Config{
        dispatch_cooldown: integer(),
        engine: atom(),
        get_dynamic_repo: nil or (-> atom() or pid()) or {atom(), atom(), list(term())},
        insert_trigger: boolean(),
        log:
          :alert or :critical or :debug or :emergency or :error or false or :info or :notice or
            :warning,
        node: binary(),
        notifier: {atom(), list({atom(), term()})},
        peer: {atom(), list({atom(), term()})},
        plugins: list(atom() or {atom() or list({atom(), term()})}),
        prefix: false or binary(),
        queues: list({atom(), list({atom(), term()})}),
        repo: atom(),
        shutdown_grace_period: integer(),
        stage_interval: :infinity or integer(),
        testing: :disabled or :inline or :manual
      } or nil,
    conflict?: boolean(),
    replace:
      nil or
        list(
          list(
            :args or :max_attempts or :meta or :priority or :queue or :scheduled_at or :tags or
              :worker
          ) or
            {:available or :cancelled or :completed or :discarded or :executing or :retryable or
               :scheduled or :suspended,
             list(
               list(
                 :args or :max_attempts or :meta or :priority or :queue or :scheduled_at or :tags or
                   :worker
               )
             )}
        ),
    unique:
      %{
        fields: list(:args or :meta or :queue or :worker),
        keys: list(atom()),
        period:
          :infinity or integer() or
            {integer(),
             :day or :days or :hour or :hours or :minute or :minutes or :second or :seconds or
               :week or :weeks},
        states:
          :all or :incomplete or :scheduled or :successful or
            list(
              :available or :cancelled or :completed or :discarded or :executing or :retryable or
                :scheduled or :suspended
            ),
        timestamp: :inserted_at or :scheduled_at
      } or nil,
    unsaved_error:
      %{
        kind: :error or :exit or :throw or {:EXIT, pid()},
        reason: term(),
        stacktrace:
          list(
            {atom(), atom(), integer() or list(term()), list({atom(), term()})} or
              {fun(), integer() or list(term()), list({atom(), term()})}
          )
      } or nil
  },
  meta: map(),
  snooze: integer(),
  start_mono: integer(),
  start_time: integer(),
  stop_mono: integer(),
  timer: reference(),
  worker: atom(),
  safe: boolean(),
  duration: integer(),
  queue_time: integer(),
  stacktrace:
    list(
      {atom(), atom(), integer() or list(term()), list({atom(), term()})} or
        {fun(), integer() or list(term()), list({atom(), term()})}
    ),
  state: :cancelled or :discard or :exhausted or :failure or :snoozed or :success or :unset
}
